title: Machine
description: A fabrication machine the user owns. Field names follow Project BINGO's node machine record ({machine_id, driver, make/model, process, envelope_mm, materials[], tier}) so a machine on a bench and a machine offered to the network describe themselves the same way rather than diverging.

process.description: BINGO uses the same token for routing a job to a capable node.

driver.description: How software talks to it: moonraker, bambu, octoprint, linuxcnc, manual.

tier.description: BINGO capability tier. 0 hobbyist FDM, 1 professional, 2 certified shop, 3 specialised. Declaring a tier is a claim about evidence you can produce, not about your equipment.

materials.description: Lowercase material tokens the machine can actually run, e.g. pla, petg, abs, asa, pc, pa, tpu.

measured_throughput.description: Only ever a figure the owner measured. Absent means print time cannot be estimated and the answer is 'requires slicing' — a slicer is the only honest source, and a volumetric guess would be an invented number.
